name: hcportal_respondToNewsflash
description: Records the authenticated user's response to a newsflash. Upserts a single HC.PortalNewsflashRead row per user per newsflash. 'I've read it' (@isDismissed=1) permanently dismisses the newsflash. 'Read Later' (@isDismissed=0) snoozes it until the next calendar day (NextShowDate = tomorrow's UTC date). Responds to soft-deleted newsflashes: a user may dismiss a newsflash that was deleted after it was shown to them. Device-bound portal auth via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; any signed-in portal user, for themselves.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with NULL callerParamString.

parameters.name: newsflashId
parameters.description: Required: the newsflash being responded to. Validated for NULL before auth.

parameters.name: isDismissed
parameters.description: Required: 1 = permanently dismissed ('I've read it'); 0 = snoozed until tomorrow ('Read Later'). Validated for NULL before auth.
parameters.typeMismatch: SMALLINT parameter vs PortalNewsflashRead.IsDismissed BIT; any non-zero value is stored as 1.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on every outcome: success, NULL @newsflashId / @isDismissed (checked BEFORE auth), auth failure, 'Newsflash not found', or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success, error message on failure

sideEffects: UPSERT HC.PortalNewsflashRead (NewsflashId, HasherId, IsDismissed, NextShowDate, UpdatedAt) — UPDATE if row exists, INSERT otherwise

codeSmells.issue: Check-then-INSERT on a UNIQUE key without UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK
codeSmells.detail: Lines 75-93: IF EXISTS … ELSE INSERT on HC.PortalNewsflashRead, which has UNIQUE (NewsflashId, HasherId), with no lock hint on the existence check. Two concurrent responses (double tap, two tabs) can both insert and the second fails with a duplicate-key error.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 99-102: CATCH returns the envelope without an HC.ErrorLog row, so the duplicate-key failure above leaves no trace.
Line 6/70-73: a value other than 0 or 1 (e.g. 2) is stored as IsDismissed = 1 (BIT) but with a snooze NextShowDate, a combination the readers never expect.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the snooze logic (1 calendar day) without coordinating with the portal client
